in_marathi.name: Shahabuddin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shahabuddin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shahabuddin is derived from the Persian words 'Shah' which means 'King' or 'Ruler' and 'Abdullah' which means 'Servant of Allah'. The name therefore signifies 'Ruler of the World' or 'Servant of Allah who rules the world'.
